concept.name: When the house looks nothing like the WhatsApp photos
concept.mechanism: Relatable comedy / before-after expectation vs reality (UGC energy, original acting or B-roll).
inspirationNotes: Travel/food creators use ‘menu vs plate’ reveals — mechanism is expectation gap, not their footage.
Kenyan X/TikTok already jokes about listing photos; we own the *solution* not the insult.
concept.nyumbaSpin: Punchline lands on map + verified listings, not dunking on a specific landlord.
concept.searchIntent: how to avoid rental scams Kenya
concept.hook: When the WhatsApp photos and the actual house are not even cousins.
concept.keyMessage: House hunting shouldn't be a surprise viewing.
concept.cta: Browse real listings on NyumbaSearch — then go view.
concept.kenyanContext: WhatsApp is how most Nairobi hunting still happens. Humour stays non-defamatory.

concept.name: POV: three weekends hunting, then one search
concept.mechanism: POV structure (global) localised to Nairobi weekend viewings / matatu time, not copied dialogue.
inspirationNotes: POV formats work because identity + time-pain, not because of a specific creator’s lines.
Sports/tech demos: ‘stop doing it the long way’ product contrast.
concept.nyumbaSpin: Weekend wasted on dead leads vs map search on NyumbaSearch. No fake ‘we found your home in 2 minutes’ claims.
concept.searchIntent: how to find a house in Nairobi
concept.hook: POV: You've already spent three Saturdays house hunting.

concept.kenyanContext: Saturday viewings + traffic are local; keep slang light unless it fits the speaker naturally.
